name: Buy rsETH below Kelp's NAV and redeem it through the withdrawal queue
thesis: rsETH trades a near-permanent discount to the NAV Kelp pays on redemption (hourly median 27.9bp over the last 210 days, 14.3bp over two years) because the queue that pays it takes a median 5 to 12 days. A $3M bid that buys behind sellers and queues every fill made $41,838 a year out of sample on the 210-day window and $44,120 on the two-year one, both with intervals clear of zero.
mechanism: Kelp's LRTWithdrawalManager pays rsETH redemptions at rsETHPrice at the request, with no accrual during the queue: 4,620 payouts over two years at a median 0.0bp from it (10th to 90th percentile -0.35 to +0.42bp). The queue is slow (median 12.0 days over the 210 days, 90th percentile 23.1, longest 30.1) and holders who will not wait sell on Fluid's rsETH/ETH pool 20 to 30bp under NAV. Net of two pool fees and the queue's staking carry, the median fill keeps 18.3bp. What binds is the rsETH sold below NAV ($20.7M in 210 days), not capital: $10M earns $43,488 against $41,838 at $3M.
legs: buy rsETH behind a seller on Fluid rsETH/ETH (or the Uniswap v4 rsETH/ETH pool) when the median venue's discount less one pool fee clears the queue's carry
fund each fill with WETH borrowed against wstETH collateral (Aave e-mode, 1.96% on 2026-10-09) so waiting capital keeps earning staking; repay when the queue pays
LRTWithdrawalManager.initiateWithdrawal for ETH, which fixes the payout at rsETHPrice at the request
wait for the unlock: median 12.0 days, 90th percentile 23.1, longest 30.1 over the 210-day window
complete the withdrawal and receive ETH
kill_criteria: trailing 90-day value of the simulated bid under $10,000 a year at $3M (it was $38,932 on the two-year run and $40,915 on the 210-day run at 2026-10-09)
Kelp queue median above 25 days for a month, where staking carry consumes most of the discount
payouts more than 2bp from rsETHPrice at the request (dislocation_history redemption_check)
rsETH hourly volume-weighted discount below 10bp at the median over 30 days
Kelp enables instant ETH withdrawal at a fee below the prevailing discount (50bp and disabled at the 2026-10-10 read)
risks: a loss in Kelp's restaked positions during the queue lands on queued withdrawals, which are paid at the lower of the request and payout NAV
queue length varies and lengthens in stress: 22 days at the median in May 2026, 30 days at the longest
Kelp's oracle stalls: rsETHPrice was unchanged on 35 of the 210 days and took a single 19.4bp step on 2026-05-16
one thin venue: almost all rsETH volume is one Fluid pool whose fee (1bp) is assumed, not read
competing bidders are not modelled, so the value is a ceiling for one participant
the three ETH queue bids (Lido, ether.fi, Kelp) dislocate together and share the same collateral: in a stress they are one book, so their dollars a year are not additive
the borrow collateral is stETH-family and is marked down in exactly the stress the bid buys into: keep the loan-to-value low

name: Buy stETH and wstETH below par and redeem them through Lido's withdrawal queue
thesis: stETH trades below the one ETH that Lido's queue pays, by 10bp or more in 18.4% of trading hours over two years and by 20 to 46bp through recurring stress weeks, while the queue pays in a median 2 days. A $10M bid that buys behind sellers when the whole market shows the discount, and queues every fill, made $129,884 a year out of sample on the second year of a two-year window.
mechanism: Lido's WithdrawalQueueERC721 pays one ETH per stETH (78,249 claims over two years checked), with the amount fixed at the request. When ETH borrow rates spike or the validator exit queue lengthens, leveraged stETH positions unwind into Curve and Uniswap and the market discount widens: 28.4bp the week of 2025-01-30, 27.0bp on 2025-07-17, 19 to 27bp through August 2025 while the queue ran 12.8 days, 46.0bp the week of 2026-04-16. A bid that buys at the median venue's price less one fee and pays the queue's staking carry keeps a median 4.4bp per fill across 2,629 out-of-sample fills at $10M. It is capital-bound: $1.38B of $12.8B qualifying sales filled at $10M over two years, and value keeps scaling to $30M ($401,697 a year out of sample).
legs: buy stETH on Curve (stETH/ETH, stETH-ng) or wstETH on Fluid or Uniswap v3 behind a seller when the median venue's discount less one pool fee clears the queue's carry
fund each fill with WETH borrowed against wstETH collateral (Aave e-mode, 1.96% on 2026-10-09) so waiting capital keeps earning staking; repay when the queue pays
requestWithdrawals on Lido's WithdrawalQueueERC721 (unwrap wstETH first)
wait for finalization: median 2.0 days over two years, 12.8 in August 2025, 9.2 in April 2026
kill_criteria: trailing 90-day value of the simulated bid under $10,000 a year at $10M (it was $19,548 at 2026-10-09, the quietest quarter in two years)
Lido queue median above 14 days for a month: at 0.74bp a day of staking carry that is about 10bp, the size of a typical stress discount
any claim paying less than one ETH per stETH, or Lido bunker mode on
hourly volume-weighted stETH discount p90 below 3bp over a trailing 90 days (the two-year p90 was 14.4bp)
risks: competing queue arbitrageurs take the same sales; the simulation lets the bid take every qualifying sale its capital allows, so the value is a ceiling for one participant
the queue lengthens exactly when discounts widen (12.8 days in August 2025), raising carry and slashing exposure together
per-fill edge is small (median 4.4bp): a 1-2bp error in fees or NAV matters
the bid is ETH-denominated: dollar capital carries ETH price risk unless hedged
the three ETH queue bids (Lido, ether.fi, Kelp) dislocate together and share the same collateral: in a stress they are one book, so their dollars a year are not additive
the borrow collateral is stETH-family and is marked down in exactly the stress the bid buys into: keep the loan-to-value low

quotes.note: two-year window: hurdle (1bp) chosen 2024-09-26..2025-10-03, scored 2025-10-03..2026-10-09: $129,884 a year at $10M (95% interval $75,037 to $194,241), 2,629 fills, median edge 4.4bp; trailing 90 days $19,548; on the 210-day window alone the 20bp hurdle chosen from one stress week never triggered (out of sample $0 at $10M)

name: Buy weETH below ether.fi's NAV and redeem it through the withdrawal queue
thesis: weETH trades below the eETH it unwraps to, by 10bp or more in 18.1% of trading hours over two years, while ether.fi's queue pays in a median 2 days. A $10M bid that buys behind sellers when the whole market shows the discount and queues every fill made $169,784 a year out of sample on the two-year window, and $41,077 on the quiet second half of the 210-day window, both with intervals clear of zero.
mechanism: weETH unwraps to eETH at getRate() and ether.fi's WithdrawRequestNFT queue pays eETH out as ETH. Discounts open when leveraged weETH positions unwind: 30.0bp on Curve the week of 2025-07-17, 61.9bp on Uniswap v3 the week of 2026-04-16. ether.fi's instant redemption into stETH (10bp fee) takes the deepest part in a stress (11,183 instant redemptions in April 2026); the queue bid lives on the discounts below that fee, with a median edge of 3.3bp across 1,961 out-of-sample fills at $10M. It is capital-bound: value keeps scaling to $30M ($411,361 a year out of sample).
legs: buy weETH on Fluid weETH/ETH, Curve weETH/WETH or Uniswap v3 behind a seller when the median venue's discount less one pool fee clears the queue's carry
fund each fill with WETH borrowed against wstETH collateral (Aave e-mode, 1.96% on 2026-10-09) so waiting capital keeps earning staking; repay when the queue pays
unwrap to eETH and request withdrawal on ether.fi's WithdrawRequestNFT
wait for finalization: median 2.0 days over two years (counters read daily), 10.1 in August 2025
kill_criteria: trailing 90-day value of the simulated bid under $10,000 a year at $10M (it was $43,315 at 2026-10-09)
ether.fi queue median above 10 days for a month
ether.fi's instant redemption fee into stETH cut below 5bp (10bp at the 2026-10-10 read), which hands the discount to the atomic route
a payout check (WithdrawRequestNFT claims against getRate at the request) more than 2bp off, once it is run
risks: the payouts were not checked against weETH's rate in this study; run the check before sizing up
competing bidders and ether.fi's instant route take the same discounts; the value is a ceiling for one participant
queue length rises in stress (10.1 days in August 2025) and is measured only to a day
the three ETH queue bids (Lido, ether.fi, Kelp) dislocate together and share the same collateral: in a stress they are one book, so their dollars a year are not additive
the borrow collateral is stETH-family and is marked down in exactly the stress the bid buys into: keep the loan-to-value low
